name: Sakihata Rimi
source:
A mysterious pink-haired girl that claims to be [url=/c4655]Takumi[/url]'s classmate and friend. 
Takumi, however, has no memory of her, and the circumstances in which he meets her make it even harder for him to trust her. 

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaos;Head]Wikipedia[/url]]
